async () => { if (!window.rooms['server_room']) await window.loadRoom('server_room'); const r = window.rooms['server_room']; if (!r) return 'not-loaded'; for (const id of ''.split(',').filter(Boolean)) { const n = window.npcManager && window.npcManager.npcs.get(id); if (n && n._sprite) n._sprite.setVisible(true); } const cam = (window.lightingSystem?.scene || window.game).cameras.main; cam.stopFollow(); cam.centerOn(r.position.x + r.map.widthInPixels / 2, r.position.y + r.map.heightInPixels / 2); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400)); const s = window.lightingSystem?.rooms.get('server_room'); return s ? (s.on ? 'on' : 'off') : 'no-lighting'; }

async () => { const L = window.lightingSystem; if (!L) return 'no-lighting'; const t = L.lastDraw; await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 300)); const s = L.rooms.get('server_room'); return s ? ('mode=' + s.mode + ' variant=' + s.variantIdx + ' lit=#' + s.litAmbient.toString(16) + ' redraw=' + Math.round(L.lastDraw - t) + 'ms') : 'unregistered'; }
async () => { window.lightingSystem.switchOn('server_room', { animate: false }); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 300)); return 1; }
() => { window.lightingSystem.switchOff('server_room'); return 1; }
